title: COVID-19 Vaccines Are Safe and Effective - CDC Confirms

claims.text: COVID-19 vaccines have been tested in rigorous clinical trials with over 40,000 participants.
claims.explanation: True. Pfizer and Moderna both conducted Phase 3 trials with 40,000+ participants.

claims.text: The CDC and WHO recommend COVID-19 vaccination for all eligible individuals.
claims.explanation: True. Both organizations strongly recommend vaccination.

claims.text: Myocarditis after vaccination is extremely rare and usually mild.
claims.explanation: True. Cases of myocarditis are rare (1 in 50,000) and most recover quickly.

claims.text: Vaccines significantly reduce transmission and severe disease.
claims.explanation: True. Vaccines reduce transmission by 60-80% and severe disease by 90%+.

claims.text: Over 13 billion vaccine doses have been administered globally with excellent safety records.
claims.explanation: True. Vaccine safety monitoring continues globally.

trust_score_description: High - All claims are backed by credible scientific sources
